description: Designs PDF signing templates with page overlays, field palette, selection, and field settings.

parameters.name: Documents
parameters.description: Document pages available for template design.

parameters.name: AllowedFieldTypes
parameters.description: Field types visible in the palette. Defaults to common signing field types.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to preview localized field labels.

parameters.name: CultureChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the designer preview culture changes.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether editing controls should be disabled.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized field labels are missing.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Current signing fields.

parameters.name: FieldsChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the signing fields collection changes.

parameters.name: MobileMode
parameters.description: Whether to render a compact mobile-oriented designer layout.

parameters.name: OnDetectFields
parameters.description: Optional async detector that returns fields to add to the template.

parameters.name: PageIndex
parameters.description: Current page index used when <see cref="ViewMode"/> is <see cref="DocumentPageViewMode.SinglePage"/>.

parameters.name: PageIndexChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the current page index changes.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Current document zoom scale shared by rendered pages.

parameters.name: ScaleChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the document zoom scale changes.

parameters.name: SelectedSubmitterUuid
parameters.description: Currently selected submitter role identifier used for new fields.

parameters.name: ShowCulturePreview
parameters.description: Whether to show culture preview and localized text authoring controls.

parameters.name: SubmitterRoles
parameters.description: Signer roles available for assigning newly created fields.

parameters.name: SupportedCultures
parameters.description: Cultures available for previewing and authoring localized field text.

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: Current page presentation mode. Defaults to single page for editing precision.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the page presentation mode changes.

parameters.name: ZoomMode
parameters.description: Current document zoom behavior.

parameters.name: ZoomModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the document zoom behavior changes.
